verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Navan's AI capabilities (MCP, Ava assistant) are query/chat-based and require explicit user confirmation before actions (navan-docs-16), not autonomous background automations that run without user initiation. Webhooks and APIs exist but no documentation of scheduled/triggered agentic workflows a user can set up to run unattended. Missing for 10: any documented scheduling/trigger mechanism, autonomous workflow builder, or evidence of unattended execution.
